# Cinemora Studios

> Cinemora Studios is a founder-led creative growth studio that builds personal brands, content systems, websites, and AI operations designed to turn attention into qualified clients.

- Personal branding and positioning

## Selected documented outcomes

- More than 50 million organic views generated or managed
- Content systems supporting $238 million in real estate sales
- Spoken Wines grew from 1,000 to 10,000 YouTube subscribers
- Success School grew from approximately $10K–$20K monthly revenue to $100K months

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Who will actually be working on our project?
A: Cinemora leads strategy and creative direction directly, with selected specialists supporting production, design, and delivery when the project scope needs it.

Q: How do you communicate and manage work?
A: Clear milestones, regular check-ins, and one shared communication channel so decisions, feedback, and progress stay visible.

Q: What do you need to start working together?
A: A clear goal, access to relevant brand materials, and an initial discovery conversation are enough to shape the first plan.

Q: What happens after launch?
A: Ongoing refinement, optimization, and creative support after the first launch or campaign goes live.

Q: Can Cinemora handle branding, design, and development together?
A: Yes. Engagements can cover strategy, branding, design, content, and implementation as one connected process.

Q: What is the project investment?
A: Investment depends on scope, timeline, and support level. A clear proposal is provided before work begins.
